summary:
Phase 7: Frontend - Due Date Colors & Integration completed.

**Completed:**
- getDueDateColor() - correct color logic (red <=2, orange <=5, green >5, error for overdue)
- QueryClientProvider - added to main.tsx for React Query support
- ErrorBoundary - global error handling component
- End-to-end flow - all components wired together

**Build Verification:**
